chemistry-killer-09.title: Mole
chemistry-killer-09.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-09.material: Pakupisa nepressure zvakagadzikana, magasi A naB anopindura kuumba gasi C mu $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$. 20 mL ye A ne 60 mL ye B zvinopindura chaizvo kupa 40 mL ye C. Huremu hwemolecule ye A i 28 uye hwe B i 2. Sanganiswa ye 100 mL ye A naB (average molecular mass 12.4) inopindurwa zvizere pakupisa nepressure zvakafanana. Density yesanganiswa yemagasi mushure mereaction ndeye nguva mangani density yesanganiswa yemagasi pamberi pereaction?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.prompt: Pakupisa nepressure zvakagadzikana, magasi A naB anopindura kuumba gasi C mu $\mathrm{aA(g) + bB(g) \rightarrow cC(g)}$. 20 mL ye A ne 60 mL ye B zvinopindura chaizvo kupa 40 mL ye C. Huremu hwemolecule ye A i 28 uye hwe B i 2. Sanganiswa ye 100 mL ye A naB (average molecular mass 12.4) inopindurwa zvizere pakupisa nepressure zvakafanana. Density yesanganiswa yemagasi mushure mereaction ndeye nguva mangani density yesanganiswa yemagasi pamberi pereaction?
chemistry-killer-09.s.s1.explain:
Nhanho 1: Reshiyo yavhoriyamu A:B:C = 20:60:40 = 1:3:2, kureva $\mathrm{A + 3B \rightarrow 2C}$.
Nhanho 2: Mu sanganiswa ye 100 mL regai A = x mL: (28x + 2(100 - x))/100 = 12.4, saka 26x + 200 = 1240 uye x = 40 mL. A = 40 mL, B = 60 mL.
Nhanho 3: 60 mL yose ye B inopindura, ichishandisa 20 mL ye A ichipa 40 mL ye C. Mushure mereaction: A 20 mL + C 40 mL = 60 mL.
Nhanho 4: Huremu hunochengetwa (cheka: pamberi 40 x 28 + 60 x 2 = 1240; C ine molecular mass (28 + 3 x 2)/2 = 17, mushure 20 x 28 + 40 x 17 = 1240). Pakupisa nepressure zvakafanana, density = huremu/vhoriyamu, saka mushure/pamberi = 100/60 = 5/3.
Pindura: 5/3 (a). (Sarudzo dzisiri dzakarurama: 3/5 inopesanisa reshiyo; 1 inoshandisa kuchengetedzwa kwehuremu asi ichinyima shanduko yevhoriyamu; 5/4 inosiya zvisina kururama 40 mL ye A, ichipa huwandu hwose hwe 80 mL.)

chemistry-killer-09.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
